_comment: Ubuntu Mono Regular at size 11.0, for GUI scale 3. GENERATED by genfonts2.py - do not hand-edit; there are sixteen of these and EyeFont picks. ONE DECLARATION PER SCALE, because the glyph atlas is uploaded with blur=false and therefore sampled GL_NEAREST: the quad is pixelWidth/oversample GUI units wide, so texels-per-physical-pixel is oversample/guiScale and only a ratio of exactly 1 is artifact-free. 4/2 discards rows (thin, broken stems); 2/3 duplicates some rows of a stem and not others (variable stroke width). Both were shipped and reported. AND ONE DECLARATION PER SIZE, for the same reason: a smaller font in the info box has to be a smaller CUT, never a pose scale over the size-11 atlas.
